facts.fact: Journalists Syndicate head Khaled El-Balshy announced a bill regulating the right to access information had been submitted to the House of Representatives, adopted by MP Maha Abdel Nasser with 60 MPs' signatures, per Al Jazeera Net.
Journalists Syndicate deputy head Mohamed Saad Abdel Hafez said government and parliament had dragged their feet for 12 years in issuing the access to information law the 2014 constitution requires.

EGY.note: The document states no government consultation on a digital law; it mentions only that hearings are expected.
